The abstract mentions RAG only as a source of vulnerabilities. The experiments cover jailbreak detection on ToxicChat and PII leakage detection on labeled LLM interactions. It does not say that a RAG system is proposed or evaluated. The paper is a defense framework for LLMs generally, so it is probably not a RAG paper. Still, the PII leakage scenario might involve RAG, and the abstract does not rule that out. Because of that uncertainty, MAYBE is safer than E1.
